Percent change in revenue on the period before. */ trend: number } interface Leaderboard2Props { currency?: string /** Defaults to a sentence about the leader and how many reps passed quota. */ description?: string /** Leave out, or pass none, to show the empty state. */ reps?: SalesRep[] status?: BlockStatus title: string } const exampleProps: Leaderboard2Props = { currency: 'USD', reps: [ { id: 1, name: 'Sarah Chen', avatar: '/images/avatar-01.webp', deals: 42, quota: 150_000, revenue: 184_300, trend: 12.4, }, { id: 2, name: 'Marcus Reid', avatar: '/images/avatar-02.webp', deals: 37, .join('') } function summarize(reps: SalesRep[], format: (value: number) => string) { const [first, second] = reps if (!first) return 'No closed deals yet.' const lead = second ? `${first.name} leads with ${format(first.revenue)}, ${format(first.revenue - second.revenue)} ahead of ${second.name}.` : `${first.name} leads with ${format(first.revenue)}.` const past = reps.filter((rep) => rep.revenue >= rep.quota).length return `${lead} ${past} of ${reps.length} ${reps.length === 1 ? 'rep' : 'reps'} ${past === 1 ? 'is' : 'are'} past quota.` } const Leaderboard2 = (props: Leaderboard2Props) => { const { currency = 'USD', reps = [], status, title } = props const state = getBlockState(status, reps) const format = (value: number) => formatCurrency(value, { currency }) const { description = summarize(reps, format) } = props const scale = Math.max(...reps.map((rep) => rep.revenue / (rep.quota || 1)), 1) return (

{title}
